questions.question: Reconcile the principal and other purchased-debt portfolios separately; identify what further evidence is needed to compare their carrying change with statutory cash flow.
questions.evidence_required: Matching instrument,period,units and literal current-capture evidence.
questions.closure_condition: Answer the stated question with the captured evidence; remain partial when a required policy or cash-flow bridge is absent.
questions.answer: Principal book (amortised cost, POCI-style lifetime ECL) and other financial assets (FVTPL, no title, no recourse) are separately reconciled for H1 FY26, H1 FY25 and FY25. Principal book H1 FY26: 3,975 + 382 additions - 728 net collections + 383 CAEIR interest - 167 impairment = 3,845. Other FA H1 FY26: 702 + 28 - 116 - 30 FV gain = 644. Net collections = gross 773 less collection costs 45 = 728. Statutory cash-flow bridge (D003.3 p.12) and note 2 pledge/borrowings detail not in this capture, so full reconciliation to cash flow remains open.

questions.question: What are the terms, covenants and maturity profile of the interest-bearing liabilities and bank overdrafts secured by the R3,845m pledged principal book portfolio (note 2), and what covenant headroom exists at 31 March 2026?
questions.evidence_required: Note 2 borrowings table with maturity, security, covenant terms and headroom at 31 March 2026 vs 30 September 2025; period, currency (Rm) and gross/net basis stated.
questions.closure_condition: Covenant terms and headroom quantified, or explicit statement that no financial covenants apply; benign explanations (e.g. unsecured facilities) accepted if evidenced.

questions.question: What drove the fall in fair value movements on other financial assets from R74m (H1 FY25) to R30m (H1 FY26), and what is the fair value hierarchy/valuation technique (note 6.3)?
questions.evidence_required: Note 6.3 fair value hierarchy level, valuation inputs, and any commentary on collection performance or retraction events affecting other financial assets in H1 FY26 vs H1 FY25.
questions.closure_condition: Driver of the FV movement change identified with note 6.3 evidence, or explicit statement that no explanation is given; forecast consequence for FVTPL income noted.

questions.question: What ECL staging, coverage and vintage/collection-performance disclosure supports the R167m impairment loss on the principal book portfolio in H1 FY26, and how does it compare with the R173m H1 FY25 charge?
questions.target_section: Credit risk / ECL note (principal book portfolios)
questions.evidence_required: ECL staging table, coverage ratios, collection-rate assumptions and any vintage default/collection curves for principal book portfolios at 31 March 2026 vs 30 September 2025; state period, units (Rm) and gross/net basis.
